issues.title: No Internet Connection
issues.description: Device is connected to a network but cannot reach the internet.

steps.title: Check physical connection
steps.instruction: Make sure your Ethernet cable is connected properly or Wi-Fi is enabled on your device.

steps.title: Check Wi-Fi / Ethernet status
steps.instruction: Confirm your device shows a connected network in the system tray or settings panel.

steps.title: Check IP address
steps.instruction: Open network settings and confirm you have a valid IP address, not one starting with 169.254.

steps.title: Ping the gateway
steps.instruction: Run a ping test against your default gateway to confirm local network connectivity.

steps.title: Test DNS
steps.instruction: Try reaching a site by IP address. If that works but domain names fail, DNS is the issue.

steps.title: Restart network adapter
steps.instruction: Disable and re-enable your network adapter, or restart your router.

issues.solution: Restarting the network adapter and renewing the IP address typically restores connectivity.

issues.title: Wi-Fi Keeps Disconnecting
issues.description: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently throughout the day.

steps.title: Check signal strength
steps.instruction: Move closer to the access point and see if the drops stop.

steps.title: Check for interference
steps.instruction: Other electronics, microwaves, or neighboring networks can cause interference.

steps.title: Update Wi-Fi driver
steps.instruction: Outdated wireless adapter drivers are a common cause of instability.

steps.title: Disable power saving on adapter
steps.instruction: Power-saving mode can cause the adapter to drop the connection when idle.

steps.title: Forget and reconnect to network
steps.instruction: Remove the saved network profile and reconnect with the password.

issues.solution: Disabling adapter power-saving mode and updating the driver resolves most intermittent drops.

issues.title: Slow Internet
issues.description: Internet is connected but pages and downloads are unusually slow.

steps.title: Run a speed test
steps.instruction: Compare your current speed against your plan’s expected speed.

steps.title: Check connected devices
steps.instruction: Too many devices streaming or downloading can saturate bandwidth.

steps.title: Check for background updates
steps.instruction: OS or app updates can silently consume bandwidth.

steps.title: Switch to 5GHz band
steps.instruction: If on Wi-Fi, the 5GHz band is faster and less congested than 2.4GHz.

steps.title: Restart router
steps.instruction: A simple router restart clears many congestion and memory issues.

issues.solution: Switching to the 5GHz band and restarting the router usually restores expected speeds.

issues.title: DNS Not Working
issues.description: Domain names fail to resolve even though the network connection is active.

steps.title: Test with a known IP
steps.instruction: Try navigating directly to an IP address to confirm it’s a DNS-specific issue.

steps.title: Flush DNS cache
steps.instruction: Clear the local DNS resolver cache to remove stale records.

steps.title: Switch DNS servers
steps.instruction: Try a public DNS provider such as 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8.

steps.title: Restart DNS client service
steps.instruction: Restart the operating system’s DNS client service.

issues.solution: Switching to a public DNS server after flushing the cache resolves most DNS failures.

issues.title: Ethernet Not Detected
issues.description: The system does not recognize a wired Ethernet connection.

steps.title: Inspect the cable
steps.instruction: Check both ends of the Ethernet cable for damage or loose connections.

steps.title: Check the port link light
steps.instruction: A lit or blinking light on the port indicates a physical link.

steps.title: Try a different port
steps.instruction: Test the cable in another port on the router or switch.

steps.title: Update Ethernet driver
steps.instruction: An outdated or corrupted driver can prevent detection.

steps.title: Test with a different cable
steps.instruction: Swap in a known-good cable to rule out a faulty one.

issues.solution: Replacing a damaged cable or reseating the connection restores the wired link.

issues.title: VPN Connection Failed
issues.description: Corporate VPN client fails to connect or authenticate.

steps.title: Check base internet connectivity
steps.instruction: A VPN needs a working internet connection first.

steps.title: Verify credentials
steps.instruction: Confirm your username, password, and MFA code are current.

steps.title: Check VPN server status
steps.instruction: The corporate VPN gateway may be under maintenance.

steps.title: Restart VPN client
steps.instruction: Fully quit and relaunch the VPN application.

steps.title: Reinstall VPN client
steps.instruction: A corrupted client install can prevent tunnel negotiation.

issues.solution: Most VPN failures are resolved by refreshing credentials and restarting the client.

issues.title: IP Address Problem
issues.description: Device receives an invalid or conflicting IP address.

steps.title: Release current IP
steps.instruction: Release the current DHCP lease from the network adapter.

steps.title: Renew IP address
steps.instruction: Request a new address from the DHCP server.

steps.title: Check for IP conflicts
steps.instruction: Two devices may be using the same static address.

steps.title: Restart DHCP service on router
steps.instruction: Restarting the router refreshes the DHCP lease table.

issues.solution: Releasing and renewing the IP address resolves the vast majority of address conflicts.

issues.title: Cannot Access Local Network
issues.description: Device has internet access but cannot reach other devices on the local network.

steps.title: Confirm same subnet
steps.instruction: Both devices should be on the same network subnet.

steps.title: Check network profile
steps.instruction: Ensure the network is set to "Private" rather than "Public".

steps.title: Check firewall rules
steps.instruction: Local firewall settings may block file and printer sharing.

steps.title: Ping the target device
steps.instruction: Ping the other device’s IP address to test reachability.

issues.solution: Switching the network profile to Private typically restores local device visibility.

issues.title: Router Not Responding
issues.description: The router admin page or network is completely unresponsive.

steps.title: Check power and lights
steps.instruction: Confirm the router is powered on and status lights are active.

steps.title: Power cycle the router
steps.instruction: Unplug for 30 seconds, then plug back in.

steps.title: Check for firmware updates
steps.instruction: Outdated firmware can cause the router to become unresponsive.

steps.title: Factory reset as last resort
steps.instruction: If nothing else works, a factory reset may be required.

issues.solution: A power cycle resolves the majority of unresponsive router issues.

issues.title: Limited Connectivity Warning
issues.description: Windows or macOS reports "limited" or "no internet, secured" connectivity.

steps.title: Check IP configuration
steps.instruction: A self-assigned address indicates a DHCP failure.

steps.title: Restart network adapter
steps.instruction: Disable and re-enable the adapter to force a new DHCP request.

steps.title: Reset network stack
steps.instruction: Reset TCP/IP stack and Winsock catalog if applicable.

issues.solution: Resetting the network stack usually clears the limited connectivity state.

issues.title: Printer Shows Offline
issues.description: The printer appears as offline even though it is powered on.

steps.title: Check power and connection
steps.instruction: Confirm the printer is powered on and connected to the network or USB port.

steps.title: Set as default printer
steps.instruction: Ensure the correct printer is set as the default device.

steps.title: Restart print spooler
steps.instruction: Restart the print spooler service to clear a stuck state.

steps.title: Remove and re-add printer
steps.instruction: Delete the printer from your device and add it again.

issues.solution: Restarting the print spooler service brings most printers back online.

issues.title: Print Spooler Errors
issues.description: The print spooler service crashes or fails to start.

steps.title: Check spooler service status
steps.instruction: Open services and confirm the Print Spooler is running.

steps.title: Clear the print queue folder
steps.instruction: Stuck jobs in the spooler folder can crash the service.

steps.title: Restart the spooler service
steps.instruction: Stop and start the service after clearing the queue.

steps.title: Update printer driver
steps.instruction: A corrupted driver can repeatedly crash the spooler.

issues.solution: Clearing the spooler folder and restarting the service resolves most spooler crashes.

issues.title: Print Jobs Stuck in Queue
issues.description: Documents remain in the print queue and never print.

steps.title: Open the print queue
steps.instruction: View pending jobs in the printer queue window.

steps.title: Cancel stuck jobs
steps.instruction: Cancel all pending jobs, especially the oldest one.

steps.title: Restart spooler service
steps.instruction: Restarting the spooler clears any lingering job locks.

steps.title: Resend the print job
steps.instruction: Try printing the document again from the source application.

issues.solution: Cancelling stuck jobs and restarting the spooler clears the queue.

issues.title: Poor Print Quality
issues.description: Printed pages show streaks, faded text, or incorrect colors.

steps.title: Check ink or toner levels
steps.instruction: Low ink or toner is the most common cause of poor quality.

steps.title: Run a nozzle/head cleaning
steps.instruction: Use the printer’s built-in cleaning utility.

steps.title: Check paper type settings
steps.instruction: Mismatched paper settings can cause smudging or fading.

steps.title: Replace cartridge if needed
steps.instruction: A worn cartridge may need replacement even if partially full.

issues.solution: Running a nozzle cleaning cycle resolves most streaking and fading issues.

issues.title: Printer Not Found on Network
issues.description: The network printer does not appear during setup or search.

steps.title: Confirm printer network connection
steps.instruction: Check the printer’s display for its current IP address and network status.

steps.title: Confirm same subnet
steps.instruction: The computer and printer must be on the same network segment.

steps.title: Add printer by IP address
steps.instruction: Manually add the printer using its IP address instead of auto-discovery.

steps.title: Check firewall settings
steps.instruction: Firewall rules may be blocking printer discovery protocols.

issues.solution: Adding the printer manually by IP address resolves most discovery failures.

issues.title: Recurring Paper Jams
issues.description: Printer repeatedly jams even after clearing paper.

steps.title: Remove all jammed paper
steps.instruction: Carefully clear any visible jammed paper from the tray and rollers.

steps.title: Check paper quality and size
steps.instruction: Worn, curled, or mismatched paper size causes frequent jams.

steps.title: Clean the rollers
steps.instruction: Dust buildup on feed rollers reduces grip and causes misfeeds.

steps.title: Reload paper properly
steps.instruction: Fan the stack and align it correctly in the tray before printing.

issues.solution: Cleaning the feed rollers and using proper paper resolves recurring jams.

issues.title: Printer Driver Error
issues.description: Print jobs fail with a driver-related error message.

steps.title: Identify the exact error
steps.instruction: Note the specific driver error code shown.

steps.title: Remove the printer driver
steps.instruction: Uninstall the existing driver package completely.

steps.title: Download the latest driver
steps.instruction: Get the current driver from the manufacturer.

steps.title: Reinstall and test
steps.instruction: Install the fresh driver and print a test page.

issues.solution: Reinstalling a fresh driver package resolves most driver-related print failures.

issues.title: Printing Is Very Slow
issues.description: Documents take an unusually long time to print.

steps.title: Check document complexity
steps.instruction: Large images or high-resolution settings slow down printing.

steps.title: Lower print quality setting
steps.instruction: Draft mode prints significantly faster for everyday documents.

steps.title: Check connection type
steps.instruction: Wireless printing can be slower than a direct USB or wired connection.

issues.solution: Switching to draft quality or a wired connection speeds up most print jobs.

issues.title: Monitor Shows No Signal
issues.description: The monitor displays "No Signal" even though the computer is on.

steps.title: Check cable connections
steps.instruction: Ensure the video cable is firmly connected at both ends.

steps.title: Check the input source
steps.instruction: Confirm the monitor is set to the correct input (HDMI, DisplayPort, etc).

steps.title: Try a different cable
steps.instruction: Swap in a known-good cable to rule out a faulty one.

steps.title: Test with another device
steps.instruction: Connect a different device to confirm the monitor itself works.

issues.solution: Reseating the cable or switching the input source restores the signal.

issues.title: Wrong Screen Resolution
issues.description: Display appears blurry or icons are the wrong size.

steps.title: Open display settings
steps.instruction: Navigate to the display settings panel.

steps.title: Select recommended resolution
steps.instruction: Choose the resolution marked as "recommended" for your monitor.

steps.title: Update graphics driver
steps.instruction: An outdated driver can limit available resolution options.

issues.solution: Selecting the recommended resolution fixes blurry or misaligned displays.

issues.title: Multi-Monitor Setup Problems
issues.description: A second monitor is not detected or displays incorrectly.

steps.title: Check both cable connections
steps.instruction: Verify each monitor has a secure video connection.

steps.title: Detect displays
steps.instruction: Use the "Detect" option in display settings to force a re-scan.

steps.title: Set display arrangement
steps.instruction: Arrange the monitors to match their physical layout.

steps.title: Update graphics driver
steps.instruction: Multi-monitor issues are often resolved by a driver update.

issues.solution: Forcing a display detection and updating the graphics driver resolves most setups.

issues.title: Screen Flickering
issues.description: The display flickers intermittently or when running certain apps.

steps.title: Check refresh rate setting
steps.instruction: A mismatched refresh rate can cause visible flicker.

steps.title: Update graphics driver
steps.instruction: Flicker is commonly caused by an outdated or corrupted driver.

steps.title: Check cable connection
steps.instruction: A loose or damaged cable can cause intermittent flicker.

steps.title: Test with another monitor
steps.instruction: Rule out a failing display panel by testing another monitor.

issues.solution: Updating the graphics driver resolves the majority of flickering issues.

issues.title: Incorrect Display Colors
issues.description: Colors appear washed out, inverted, or tinted incorrectly.

steps.title: Check color profile
steps.instruction: An incorrect ICC color profile can distort colors.

steps.title: Reset color calibration
steps.instruction: Restore default color and gamma settings.

steps.title: Check cable type
steps.instruction: Some cables limit color depth compared to others.

issues.solution: Resetting the color profile to default corrects most color issues.

issues.title: Brightness Controls Not Working
issues.description: Brightness slider has no effect on external or laptop screen.

steps.title: Check monitor OSD controls
steps.instruction: Some external monitors require brightness to be set on the device itself.

steps.title: Update graphics driver
steps.instruction: A missing display driver can disable software brightness control.

steps.title: Check for a stuck brightness key
steps.instruction: A stuck function key can override software adjustments.

issues.solution: Updating the graphics driver typically restores software brightness control.

issues.title: Keyboard Not Detected
issues.description: The keyboard does not respond or is not recognized by the system.

steps.title: Check the connection
steps.instruction: Reseat the USB cable or check wireless receiver placement.

steps.title: Try a different port
steps.instruction: Test the keyboard in another USB port.

steps.title: Check batteries (wireless)
steps.instruction: Replace batteries if the keyboard is wireless.

steps.title: Update or reinstall driver
steps.instruction: Reinstall the keyboard driver from device manager.

issues.solution: Reseating the connection or replacing batteries resolves most keyboard detection issues.

issues.title: Mouse Not Working
issues.description: Mouse cursor does not move or clicks are unresponsive.

steps.title: Check the connection
steps.instruction: Verify the USB cable or wireless dongle is firmly connected.

steps.title: Try a different surface
steps.instruction: Optical mice can struggle on glass or reflective surfaces.

steps.title: Check batteries (wireless)
steps.instruction: Low battery is a common cause of unresponsive wireless mice.

steps.title: Test on another computer
steps.instruction: Rule out a hardware failure by testing elsewhere.

issues.solution: Replacing batteries or switching surfaces resolves the majority of mouse issues.

issues.title: Webcam Not Detected
issues.description: Video conferencing apps cannot find the webcam.

steps.title: Check physical connection
steps.instruction: Confirm the webcam is plugged in securely.

steps.title: Check camera privacy settings
steps.instruction: Operating system privacy settings may be blocking camera access.

steps.title: Close conflicting apps
steps.instruction: Another app may already be using the camera exclusively.

steps.title: Update webcam driver
steps.instruction: Reinstall or update the camera driver.

issues.solution: Enabling camera access in privacy settings resolves most detection failures.

issues.title: USB Device Not Recognized
issues.description: Windows or macOS reports an unrecognized USB device error.

steps.title: Try a different USB port
steps.instruction: Test the device in another port to rule out a faulty port.

steps.title: Test on another computer
steps.instruction: Confirm whether the device itself is faulty.

steps.title: Update USB controller driver
steps.instruction: Update or reinstall the USB host controller driver.

steps.title: Check power management settings
steps.instruction: USB selective suspend can cause devices to disconnect.

issues.solution: Updating the USB controller driver resolves most "unrecognized device" errors.

issues.title: Bluetooth Device Won’t Pair
issues.description: A Bluetooth accessory fails to pair or repeatedly disconnects.

steps.title: Confirm Bluetooth is enabled
steps.instruction: Check that Bluetooth is turned on for both devices.

steps.title: Remove and re-pair the device
steps.instruction: Delete the existing pairing and pair again from scratch.

steps.title: Check device distance
steps.instruction: Move devices closer together, away from interference sources.

steps.title: Update Bluetooth driver
steps.instruction: An outdated driver can cause pairing failures.

issues.solution: Removing and re-pairing the device resolves most Bluetooth connection problems.

issues.title: Computer Won’t Power On
issues.description: Pressing the power button produces no response.

steps.title: Check the power source
steps.instruction: Confirm the outlet and power cable are working.

steps.title: Check power supply switch
steps.instruction: Some desktop power supplies have a physical on/off switch.

steps.title: Try a different outlet
steps.instruction: Rule out a faulty outlet or power strip.

steps.title: Check for loose internal cables
steps.instruction: On desktops, confirm internal power cables are seated.

issues.solution: A faulty outlet or a loose power cable accounts for most power-on failures.

issues.title: Computer Overheating
issues.description: Device shuts down or throttles due to high temperatures.

steps.title: Check ventilation
steps.instruction: Ensure air vents are not blocked and the device is on a hard surface.

steps.title: Clean dust from fans
steps.instruction: Dust buildup significantly reduces cooling efficiency.

steps.title: Check background processes
steps.instruction: High CPU usage from an app can drive up temperatures.

steps.title: Monitor temperatures
steps.instruction: Use a diagnostic tool to confirm temperatures return to normal.

issues.solution: Clearing dust and improving airflow resolves most overheating issues.

issues.title: Blue Screen / System Crash
issues.description: System crashes with a stop error and restarts unexpectedly.

steps.title: Note the error code
steps.instruction: Record the stop code shown on the crash screen.

steps.title: Check recent changes
steps.instruction: Recently installed drivers or hardware are common causes.

steps.title: Run memory diagnostic
steps.instruction: Faulty RAM is a frequent cause of random crashes.

steps.title: Update drivers
steps.instruction: Update graphics and chipset drivers to the latest stable version.

issues.solution: Identifying and updating the driver associated with the stop code resolves most crashes.

issues.title: Computer Running Slow
issues.description: General sluggishness across applications and startup.

steps.title: Check startup programs
steps.instruction: Too many apps launching at startup slows the whole system.

steps.title: Check available storage
steps.instruction: Low free disk space significantly impacts performance.

steps.title: Check for malware
steps.instruction: Run a security scan to rule out background malicious processes.

steps.title: Check for pending updates
steps.instruction: Pending OS updates can silently consume resources.

issues.solution: Disabling unnecessary startup apps and freeing disk space restores most of the speed.

issues.title: Laptop Battery Draining Fast
issues.description: Battery depletes much faster than expected.

steps.title: Check battery health
steps.instruction: View the battery health report to check for degradation.

steps.title: Check power-hungry apps
steps.instruction: Identify apps consuming excessive background power.

steps.title: Adjust screen brightness
steps.instruction: Lowering brightness meaningfully extends battery life.

steps.title: Update battery drivers
steps.instruction: Outdated power management drivers can cause inaccurate drain.

issues.solution: Adjusting brightness and closing power-hungry background apps extends battery life significantly.

issues.title: No Sound Output
issues.description: No audio plays from speakers or headphones.

steps.title: Check volume and mute
steps.instruction: Confirm the system and application volume are not muted.

steps.title: Check output device
steps.instruction: Ensure the correct playback device is selected.

steps.title: Check physical connections
steps.instruction: Verify speaker or headphone cables are fully seated.

steps.title: Update audio driver
steps.instruction: Reinstall or update the audio driver.

issues.solution: Selecting the correct output device resolves most no-sound issues.

issues.title: Microphone Not Working
issues.description: Other participants cannot hear you during calls.

steps.title: Check mute status
steps.instruction: Confirm the microphone is not muted in the app or on hardware.

steps.title: Check input device
steps.instruction: Ensure the correct microphone is selected as the input device.

steps.title: Check microphone privacy settings
steps.instruction: The OS may be blocking app access to the microphone.

steps.title: Test input levels
steps.instruction: Speak and confirm the input meter registers activity.

issues.solution: Enabling microphone access in privacy settings resolves most mute complaints.

issues.title: Audio Device Conflicts
issues.description: Multiple audio devices cause playback to switch unexpectedly.

steps.title: Review connected audio devices
steps.instruction: List all currently connected playback and recording devices.

steps.title: Set a fixed default device
steps.instruction: Manually set your preferred device as default instead of automatic switching.

steps.title: Disable unused devices
steps.instruction: Disable audio devices you rarely use to reduce switching conflicts.

issues.solution: Setting a fixed default device prevents unwanted automatic switching.

issues.title: Application Keeps Crashing
issues.description: A specific application closes unexpectedly or freezes.

steps.title: Check for updates
steps.instruction: Update the application to the latest available version.

steps.title: Clear application cache
steps.instruction: Corrupted cache files can cause repeated crashes.

steps.title: Check system compatibility
steps.instruction: Confirm the app supports your current operating system version.

steps.title: Reinstall the application
steps.instruction: A clean reinstall resolves most persistent crash issues.

issues.solution: Reinstalling the application after clearing its cache resolves most crashes.

issues.title: Installation Fails
issues.description: Software installer returns an error and does not complete.

steps.title: Check available disk space
steps.instruction: Insufficient storage is a common install blocker.

steps.title: Run installer as administrator
steps.instruction: Some installers require elevated permissions.

steps.title: Disable antivirus temporarily
steps.instruction: Security software can sometimes block legitimate installers.

steps.title: Download a fresh installer
steps.instruction: A corrupted download can cause installation failures.

issues.solution: Running the installer as administrator with sufficient disk space resolves most failures.

issues.title: Software Licensing Error
issues.description: Application reports an invalid or expired license.

steps.title: Check license status
steps.instruction: Verify your license or subscription is currently active.

steps.title: Sign out and back in
steps.instruction: Refresh the license token by re-authenticating.

steps.title: Check system date and time
steps.instruction: Incorrect system clock can invalidate license checks.

steps.title: Contact IT for reactivation
steps.instruction: Escalate to IT if the license should be active but shows expired.

issues.solution: Signing out and back in refreshes the license token in most cases.

issues.title: Slow Startup
issues.description: The operating system takes an unusually long time to boot.

steps.title: Check startup applications
steps.instruction: Disable non-essential apps from launching at boot.

steps.title: Check for pending updates
steps.instruction: Updates installing at boot can significantly delay startup.

steps.title: Check disk health
steps.instruction: A failing or nearly full drive slows boot dramatically.

issues.solution: Disabling unnecessary startup apps significantly reduces boot time.

issues.title: System Update Fails
issues.description: Operating system update repeatedly fails to install.

steps.title: Check available disk space
steps.instruction: Updates require sufficient free space to install.

steps.title: Check internet connection stability
steps.instruction: An unstable connection can interrupt the download.

steps.title: Run update troubleshooter
steps.instruction: Built-in troubleshooting tools can repair common update issues.

steps.title: Restart and retry
steps.instruction: A restart often clears whatever blocked the previous attempt.

issues.solution: Freeing disk space and running the built-in update troubleshooter resolves most failures.

issues.title: System Freezes Randomly
issues.description: The entire system becomes unresponsive without warning.

steps.title: Check recent software changes
steps.instruction: Recently installed apps or drivers are common culprits.

steps.title: Check system resource usage
steps.instruction: A runaway process can consume all available memory or CPU.

steps.title: Run system diagnostics
steps.instruction: Check for hardware issues affecting stability.

steps.title: Update all drivers
steps.instruction: Outdated drivers are a frequent cause of full-system freezes.

issues.solution: Updating drivers and identifying the resource-heavy process resolves most freezing issues.

issues.title: Cannot Log In to Account
issues.description: Login attempts fail with incorrect credentials or lockout messages.

steps.title: Verify credentials
steps.instruction: Double-check username and password for typos.

steps.title: Check caps lock
steps.instruction: A stray caps lock is a common cause of failed logins.

steps.title: Reset password if needed
steps.instruction: Use the self-service password reset if available.

steps.title: Contact IT for account lockout
steps.instruction: Repeated failed attempts may require IT to unlock the account.

issues.solution: A self-service password reset resolves the majority of login failures.

issues.title: MFA Code Not Working
issues.description: Multi-factor authentication codes are rejected or not received.

steps.title: Check device time sync
steps.instruction: Authenticator codes fail if the device clock has drifted.

steps.title: Check network connection for SMS/push
steps.instruction: Confirm the device can receive SMS or push notifications.

steps.title: Regenerate the code
steps.instruction: Wait for a fresh code rather than reusing an expired one.

steps.title: Use backup codes
steps.instruction: Use previously saved backup codes if the primary method fails.

issues.solution: Syncing the device clock resolves the majority of rejected MFA codes.

issues.title: Suspicious Account Activity
issues.description: Unusual sign-in alerts or unrecognized activity on an account.

steps.title: Review recent sign-in activity
steps.instruction: Check the account’s sign-in log for unfamiliar locations or devices.

steps.title: Change your password immediately
steps.instruction: Set a new, strong password as a precaution.

steps.title: Revoke unfamiliar sessions
steps.instruction: Sign out any sessions you don’t recognize.

steps.title: Report to IT security
steps.instruction: Escalate confirmed suspicious activity to the security team.

issues.solution: Changing the password and revoking unfamiliar sessions contains most account compromises.

issues.title: Low Disk Space
issues.description: System warns that available storage is critically low.

steps.title: Check largest files and folders
steps.instruction: Identify what is consuming the most space.

steps.title: Empty recycle bin / trash
steps.instruction: Deleted files often remain until the bin is emptied.

steps.title: Clear temporary files
steps.instruction: Temporary and cache files can accumulate significantly over time.

steps.title: Move files to external storage
steps.instruction: Offload large infrequently used files to free up space.

issues.solution: Clearing temporary files and emptying the recycle bin frees up meaningful space quickly.

issues.title: Drive Not Detected
issues.description: An internal or external drive does not appear in the system.

steps.title: Check physical connection
steps.instruction: Reseat the drive cable or USB connection.

steps.title: Try a different port or cable
steps.instruction: Rule out a faulty port or cable.

steps.title: Check disk management
steps.instruction: Confirm whether the OS sees the drive but hasn’t assigned a letter.

steps.title: Test on another computer
steps.instruction: Determine if the drive itself has failed.

issues.solution: Reseating the connection or assigning a drive letter resolves most detection issues.

issues.title: Slow Read/Write Speeds
issues.description: File transfers and app loading are significantly slower than expected.

steps.title: Check drive health
steps.instruction: Run a diagnostic to check for early signs of drive failure.

steps.title: Check available free space
steps.instruction: Drives slow down significantly when nearly full.

steps.title: Check for background processes
steps.instruction: Antivirus scans or sync tools can saturate disk activity.

steps.title: Check cable/interface type
steps.instruction: Confirm the drive and port support the expected transfer speed.

issues.solution: Freeing space and pausing background disk activity restores expected transfer speeds.
